instructions: Use analyze_business_sales_opportunities when a user wants to research one business from its public website before outreach. Present observations as evidence with their source URLs. Label every opportunity with is_hypothesis=true as an inference, not a fact. Treat missing signals as unknown. If coverage is partial or insufficient, say so and repeat the limitations. Never invent contacts, figures or claims. The tool handles one company per request.
